verdict.rationale: Drata's core product centers on automated evidence collection via connections/integrations (drata-docs-1, drata-docs-12), continuous 'Monitoring Tests' (drata-docs-14) and Controls (drata-docs-20), plus the Drata Agent which reads device configuration state directly rather than manual screenshots (drata-gh-1, drata-gh-2). This is the flagship capability of a compliance-automation platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of collection scheduling/cadence, independent third-party verification of timestamp integrity, and confirmation that manual screenshot/CSV workflows are fully eliminated rather than supplemented.
